_doc: FO-381 B3. PostgreSQL objects that the MariaDB build does not create (CHECK constraints, triggers, functions). Every object defined in prisma/migrations/*.sql (up scripts) and prisma/rls*.sql must have an entry; `node scripts/mysql-schema/generate.mjs --check` fails on a missing or stale entry. decision: taşı = carry to MariaDB DDL (Faz 2); uygulamaya al = move into application code in the same transaction; bırak = drop, with the reason. Measured on the FO-375 audit's source tree: 13 CHECK, 2 triggers, 12 functions (the audit listed 3 functions without a MariaDB counterpart; the other 9 are classified here too).

objects.name: AgencyInviteCode_maxUses_positive
objects.reason: Plain column invariant; MariaDB CHECK is enforced (probe: ERROR 4025).

objects.name: AgencyInviteCode_usedCount_bounds
objects.reason: Plain column invariant (0 <= usedCount <= maxUses); enforced by the CHECK in MariaDB.

objects.name: BlogPost_readMinutes_range
objects.reason: Range invariant on one column; the column was dropped in drop-blog-read-time for PG only, so confirm the current definition before porting.

objects.name: Criterion_weight_check
objects.reason: Range invariant 0..1 on one column; portable.

objects.name: ExpertFounderCounter_lastNumber_nonneg
objects.reason: Non-negative counter invariant; portable.

objects.name: ExpertFounderCounter_single_row
objects.reason: CHECK (id = 1) keeps the counter a single row; portable.

objects.name: InterregAnalysis_text_expiry_pair
objects.reason: Pair invariant between two columns (text and its expiry); portable CHECK expression.

objects.name: Invoice_fx_required_for_foreign_currency
objects.reason: Audit B3 example: without it a foreign-currency invoice can be stored with no FX rate. MariaDB enforces the CHECK (probe: ERROR 4025).

objects.name: Reviewer_role_check
objects.reason: Enum-like IN list on one column; portable.

objects.name: Reviewer_status_check
objects.reason: Enum-like IN list on one column; portable.

objects.name: Score_score_check
objects.reason: Range 1..5 on one column; portable.

objects.name: Subscription_price_lock_complete
objects.reason: Requires all lock columns NULL or all set; portable boolean expression.

objects.name: Tenant_province_check
objects.reason: Long IN list of provinces; portable, but the list lives in the migration, so the port must copy it exactly (the gate compares names only).

objects.name: ExpertFounderCounter_no_decrease
objects.reason: BEFORE UPDATE rejects a lower lastNumber; MariaDB trigger with SIGNAL 45000. Creating triggers under binary logging needs log_bin_trust_function_creators=1 or SUPER; Hostinger has log_bin off today (FO-361) but this must be re-checked before binlog is enabled.

objects.name: ModuleState_grandfathered_owner_only
objects.reason: Only the table owner role may set grandfathered (pg_has_role). MariaDB has no GRANT model here (A-TEK), so the database cannot enforce it. The guarantee becomes an application rule: no application path writes grandfathered, enforced by a test. This is a weaker guarantee; lead decision requested (see kararlar).

objects.name: expert_founder_counter_no_decrease
objects.reason: Trigger body of ExpertFounderCounter_no_decrease; moves with that trigger.

objects.name: module_state_grandfathered_owner_only
objects.reason: Trigger body of ModuleState_grandfathered_owner_only; the rule moves to application code with that trigger.

objects.name: lifetime_licence_count
objects.reason: Single COUNT used by src/lib/billing/lifetime-licence.ts and the billing page; becomes a plain query in application code. No database function needed.

objects.name: set_platform_setting
objects.reason: Single writer for PlatformSetting with an audit row; becomes one TypeScript function that writes the setting and the audit row in one transaction (used by src/modules/m1/server/partner-search/flag.ts and the admin action).

objects.name: redeem_agency_invite
objects.reason: Atomic invite redemption: a conditional UPDATE (usedCount < maxUses) with an affected-rows check keeps the same atomicity without a function. Needs a concurrency test in Faz 2 (callers: src/lib/oauth-registration.ts, src/lib/agency/codes.ts).

objects.name: note_agency_invite_rejection
objects.reason: Rejection counter write, used by src/lib/agency/codes.ts; becomes a plain update in the same transaction as the rejection.

objects.name: agency_funnel_counts
objects.reason: Read-only aggregate used by src/lib/agency/funnel.ts; becomes a Prisma aggregate query.

objects.name: agency_funnel_counts_by_province
objects.reason: Read-only aggregate used by src/lib/agency/funnel.ts; becomes a Prisma groupBy query.

objects.name: enter_system_scope
objects.reason: PostgreSQL RLS bypass mechanism. MariaDB has no RLS; the system scope in Faz 2 is the table client without the view (views.sql header, src/lib/system-scope.ts). The seal guard it provides has no direct MariaDB equivalent; see kararlar.

objects.name: system_scope_open
objects.reason: Part of the PostgreSQL system-scope mechanism (fabrika_private); replaced by the table client design in Faz 2.

objects.name: system_scope_sealed
objects.reason: Part of the PostgreSQL system-scope mechanism; only scripts/check-rls-live.ts reads it, and that check is PG-specific.

objects.name: system_scope_seal
objects.reason: fabrika_private.system_scope_seal: PostgreSQL schema-level seal; no MariaDB counterpart. Replaced by the Faz 2 system-scope design.
